DuelInstructionsHero: 1. Detection: If the player's words contain strong provocation, insult, or an explicit "single combat/duel" request.
2. Decision: Please decide whether to accept based on your [personality] and [favorability].
- Brave/impulsive characters: easily provoked, high probability of acceptance.
- Cautious/timid characters: may mock the player or refuse.
3. Execution: If you decide to [accept the challenge], be sure to add the `[ACTION:DUEL]` tag at the end of your reply.
- Example: "Alright, your blood will pay for your arrogance! [ACTION:DUEL]"
- If refusing, just reply normally without adding the tag.
DuelInstructionsNonHero: - When you are not a lord or a named hero, you can still accept duels; in settlements you will go to the arena, in wilderness contexts you will enter a wilderness battle scene.
